summary: Manual City Entry for Weather Widget

workingFiles.client/src/components/WeatherWidget.tsx: modified - added city search with Modal, geocoding API
workingFiles.client/src/components/Modal.tsx: modified - added React Portal for stable positioning

decisions: Use existing Modal component instead of inline overlay
Use React Portal (createPortal) to prevent transform-related flickering
Use Open-Meteo geocoding API for city search (free, no API key)
Debounce search input (300ms) to reduce API calls
Store selected city in localStorage for persistence

codebaseUnderstanding.modalSystem: Modal component uses fixed positioning, now with Portal to body
codebaseUnderstanding.widgetCards: WidgetCard has whileHover transform that affects fixed children
codebaseUnderstanding.weatherAPI: Uses Open-Meteo for both weather and geocoding (free tier)

nextSteps: Consider keyboard navigation for search results
